origen: reports/Estudios de branding referentes mundiales.md, apéndice A

familias.mecanismo: una sola forma geométrica con una idea adentro, probada a 16 px y en una tinta
descriptores: Timeless geometric symbol reduced to its essential idea: one or two flat shapes, strong figure-ground, works at 16 pixels and on a building; paired with a quiet, well-spaced sans-serif wordmark; no gradients, no trends.

Disciplined, idea-first identity: one clever conceptual twist inside a simple geometric mark, rational grid, restrained palette of one or two flat colors, classic sans-serif, wit expressed through reduction rather than decoration.
Clever geometric logomark with a hidden second reading: built from circles and straight segments on a grid, negative-space surprise, single flat color, playful but precise.

Strategic corporate identity: a simplified, ownable symbol with a hidden or negative-space idea, custom corporate typeface family, disciplined master palette, clear brand architecture for sub-brands, built for global scale.
Mid-century modernist corporate mark: rigorous geometric construction, single bold symbol plus clean sans logotype, flat primary colors, systematic application across infrastructure.
Rigorous optical-modernist identity: kinetic line patterns, precise geometric symbols, black-white with single strong color, museum-grade typographic restraint.

familias.mecanismo: la grilla que construye el signo ordena todo lo demás
descriptores: Rigorous Swiss-modernist identity: precise geometric mark, neo-grotesque typography, strict modular grid, generous white space, limited palette with one signature color, comprehensive guidelines-manual aesthetic, calm and authoritative.
Rigorous modernist identity: a strict grid, one disciplined sans-serif, monochrome base with a single sharp accent, geometric pattern derived from the letterforms, and a cool, intelligent restraint.

Modernist-heritage identity: Swiss-inspired grid, timeless grotesk typography, considered information hierarchy, minimal palette of warm neutrals, and print-and-space applications with architectural precision.
Geometric grid-born identity: a logo constructed from a precise modular grid that then becomes the layout system, bold flat color, contemporary poster sensibility applied to institutions.
Type as building material: modular, fragmented or stencil-like letterforms constructed on a grid, high-contrast black and one accent, posters and signage where typography becomes architecture.
Hyper-precise typographic identity: a custom modular typeface drawn on a tight grid, crisp geometric construction, vivid pop colour against neutral grounds, and meticulous print detailing.
Engineered corporate identity: precise sans typography, strict grids, monochrome base with one controlled accent, systematic guidelines built for complex organizations and digital interfaces.
Constraint-based event identity: system derived from a technical standard (ISO paper sizes), two typefaces only (ultra-condensed grotesk + light serif), limited red and black or neon palette.

familias.mecanismo: una tipografía propia o modificada es el activo principal y el símbolo queda mínimo
descriptores: Typographically driven identity: a custom or heavily modified typeface as the main brand asset, unexpected but rigorous letter details, restrained palette, layouts where type alone creates character.
Institutional identity carried by a modified display typeface with a distinctive face; flexible expandable system of project sub-identities, posters and signage sharing one typographic voice.
Type-led national-grade identity: a bespoke typeface as the core asset, calm functional grids, clear wayfinding logic, restraint with subtle warmth in letter details.
Rigorous typographic identity: a shortened, compact name as the core asset, one disciplined typeface family, clear hierarchy, and a reserved palette that reads as institutional yet contemporary.
Custom-typeface-centric brand: precise contemporary grotesk or serif drawn specifically for the client, typographic voice carrying the identity.
Typographic-conceptual identity: daring custom letterforms, posters as identity, black-and-white with one vivid color, clever cultural wordplay, strong grid, artful and intellectual.
Text-as-image identity: large carefully spaced characters as the main visual, an austere two-color scheme, crisp editorial grids, and typography that carries both meaning and composition.

Typography as architecture: oversized, stacked wordmarks in mixed weights, bleeding off edges; loud primary color blocks; posters treated as identity; letters do the work images usually do; confident, theatrical, urban.

Bilingual typographic identity: a custom wordmark where two scripts share stroke weight, baseline logic and rhythm, modern geometric reinterpretation of calligraphic forms, a restrained palette and a monumental, timeless presence.
Typographic classicism with Hispanic specificity: refined serif or humanist sans, careful treatment of ñ, ch, accents, editorial grids, sober palette, cultural gravitas.

familias.nombre: Tipografía hecha a mano y vernácula
familias.mecanismo: las letras salen de algo real: un cartel del barrio, la letra del dueño, un oficio
descriptores: Vernacular, hand-made typographic identity: letterforms drawn from local signage and painted lettering, fast confident strokes, bold flat colour, and a community-owned feel that spills into the physical environment.
Quiet, research-led cultural identity: a delicate custom typeface derived from a physical craft or artefact, soft neutral palette, precise editorial grids, and a calm, intellectual presence.
Research-heavy, quirky independent branding: bespoke handwriting-based typefaces, references from history and pop culture, bold flat color, witty tone.
Custom hand-lettered wordmark: flowing script or decorative serif with consistent stroke contrast, carefully balanced joins, optical corrections for small sizes, warm and personal yet professional.

Revived heritage identity: custom art-deco-inspired display typeface, one saturated signature color (deep yellow) against black, period ornament used sparingly, contemporary spacing that keeps the history fresh.
Vibrant city-culture identity: bold expressive type inspired by street signage and music posters, high-energy color, local language phrases, and a proud, celebratory tone.

familias.nombre: Cinético y con el movimiento primero
familias.mecanismo: primero se diseña cómo se mueve y la versión fija sale de un fotograma
descriptores: Motion-native identity: a bold expressive typeface that stretches, bounces and reacts to rhythm, saturated color fields, kinetic transitions as core brand assets, designed for screens first and printed second.

Kinetic, culture-driven identity: custom display typeface with expressive quirks, type that stretches and morphs in motion, saturated unexpected color pairings, energetic layouts that feel alive on screens, playful yet sharp.
Living, motion-native identity: a luminous dimensional symbol that rotates, morphs and glows, paired with a clean bespoke sans, designed to be experienced on screens first and printed second.
High-energy broadcast identity: kinetic typography, a modular graphic device that slices and frames footage, electric colour, and a sonic logo designed alongside the visual one.
Media identity built for motion: a typographic system that animates, crops and frames content, high-contrast black-and-white with one accent, editorial confidence, transitions as brand signature.
Type-led brand where a custom or variable typeface is the core asset; letterforms flex in weight and width with rhythm or sound, organic humanist sans details, energetic warmth.
Playful post-Swiss graphic language: vibrant clashing colors, abstract shapes in implied motion, a friendly geometric grotesque used very large, compositions that feel like music turned into posters.
Energetic festival-grade identity: oversized expressive typography, a bold clashing palette, kinetic layouts designed for motion first, and a celebratory, crowd-facing tone.

familias.mecanismo: un juego visual o una doble lectura que se explica en una frase
descriptores: Witty, craft-rich identity where a single visual pun makes the mark unforgettable; simple bold forms, playful hidden double meanings, tactile print finishes, and a smart, gently humorous voice.
Concept-first identity that hides a meaningful symbol inside the name itself; plain, robust slab or sans typography, bold primary colour, and a system open to user participation and content.

Idea-led identity where a single witty concept drives everything; confident typographic logotype, restrained palette with one decisive accent, generous white space, editorial grid, and photography treated as content rather than decoration.
Witty conceptual identity built on a single visual pun or double reading; minimal palette, clean sans typography, the idea doing the work rather than decoration.
Witty minimal identity: a single clever visual idea, clean sans-serif type, plenty of white space and a restrained palette, with humor carried by one unexpected detail rather than decoration.
Crafted, idea-led identity: a distinctive custom mark with a single memorable twist, refined typography, a confident limited palette and a durable system designed to last for years.
Conceptual record-sleeve synthesis: one striking visual idea, unexpected crops and formats, photographic or object-based imagery, minimal type.

familias.mecanismo: el espacio sin contenido es el elemento principal y la marca se corre para que hable el producto
descriptores: An identity built on deliberate emptiness: a plain wordmark in a neutral typeface, generous unprinted space, natural kraft and off-white materials, muted earth tones, and photography of everyday objects that invites the viewer to fill in meaning.
Scandinavian clarity with warmth: simple custom wordmark, soft natural palette with one confident accent, generous whitespace, human photography and calm, purposeful motion.
Narrative micro-branding: type-only or nearly type-only identities, minimal graphic devices, tender editorial tone, generous whitespace.
Minimal, crafted Scandinavian identity: understated wordmark, refined grotesque or serif, muted tonal palette, exquisite print production and precise typographic details.

Thoughtful, quietly confident identity: a simple geometric container (circle, frame) that carries rotating messages, elegant typography, muted sophisticated palette, and copy that does as much work as the graphics.

familias.mecanismo: un wordmark impecable, pocos colores y el acabado (foil, relieve, papel) como señal
descriptores: Refined minimal luxury: a precise grotesk or condensed serif wordmark, tight monogram, generous negative space, a restrained palette of off-whites and one metallic, and tactile finishes like foil and letterpress.
Fashion-grade minimalism: a stark, perfectly kerned wordmark, black and white with rare accents, complex specialist print processes as the hero, and editorial layouts with dramatic scale contrast.

Editorial, heritage-aware identity: characterful serif wordmark with generous letterspacing, warm off-white and muted earth palette, crafted print details (foil, uncoated stock), restrained layouts that feel like a well-designed book.

Ultra-refined hospitality and retail identity: minimal wordmark or monogram, impeccable spacing, premium materials and finishes (foil, embossing, colored edges), one conceptual metaphor carried into interiors and packaging.

Radically reduced, fashion-minded identity: a stark monogram or initials in a custom geometric typeface, black and white with one brutal accent, deliberately unexpected aesthetic collisions that feel confident and contemporary.
Elegant cultural identity: refined custom lettering with subtle classical references, generous margins, monochrome or tonal palettes, typography treated as sculpture in space.
Edgy boutique identity in strict black and white elevated by holographic foil, with a flexible system that changes solution per application.
Editorial-minded lifestyle identity: art direction and copywriting lead, refined serif or grotesk wordmark, muted natural palette, generous photography, witty short lines, understated luxury.

familias.mecanismo: un bloque de color o un símbolo contundente repetido con disciplina absoluta
descriptores: A blunt, iconic brand mark: a solid square block in one saturated signal color holding a bold custom wordmark set in two scripts, repeated with absolute consistency across store, bag and screen; confident, simple, unmistakable at any size.

Bold heritage-revival brand for mass consumer goods: chunky custom display type, appetising warm colours, a simplified iconic product silhouette, and confident, playful packaging built on a few ownable distinctive assets.
Civic, bold, rule-based identity: one strong graphic symbol used everywhere, high-contrast red/black/white, chunky grotesque type, unapologetically direct.
Mass-market consumer branding with shelf impact: confident wordmark, strong color blocking, clear brand architecture for product ranges, packaging-led.
Bold big-idea identity: an oversized simple mark or numeral, strong black-and-color contrast, confident heavy type, and graphics scaled to architecture and urban environments.

familias.mecanismo: la forma del envase o una palabra gigante hacen de logo
descriptores: Desire-driven packaging identity: a sculptural, iconic pack shape, a confident simplified symbol, sunny optimistic colour, and premium craft that makes everyday products feel aspirational.

Elegant premium packaging: a refined, often illustrated emblem, classic serif or engraved-style lettering, rich deep colours with metallic foils, and a timeless, understated luxury suited to spirits and fine food.
Minimal, intelligent food packaging: a single smart graphic idea per range, lots of white or solid color, small precise typography, playful use of the container shape itself.

Quietly essential packaging-minded identity: one oversized word or numeral, honest product-focused layout, a restrained two-color palette, and typography that explains the product rather than decorates it.

Typography-driven packaging identity: oversized sans-serif lettering wrapping the form, saturated deep purple, mustard and burnt orange, refuses rustic clichés to present origin products as elevated and graphic.
Packaging-first consumer brand: illustrated or hand-drawn wordmark with character, bright food-friendly colors, playful product naming on pack, shelf-stopping silhouettes, cheeky honest copy.
Bold, expressive food identity mixing two cultural codes: oversized display type, vivid contrasting colors, playful illustrative motifs and packaging that reads from a distance on a crowded shelf.
Refined premium packaging: classical serif typography, embossing and foil, muted heritage palette, illustration-like engraving details, quiet luxury.

familias.mecanismo: ilustración propia, detalles repetidos en cada punto de contacto, motivos del lugar
descriptores: Crafted, illustrative brand for food, books and hospitality: decorative-yet-useful patterns, hand-drawn or historical lettering, rich jewel colours, and storytelling details on every surface.
Charming hospitality and food identity: hand-lettered or illustrated marks, warm vintage-inspired palette, patterns and small details across menus and packaging, cozy and personal.
Warm illustrated identity: delicate watercolor and gouache drawings of ingredients or animals, soft natural palette, handcrafted labels, cozy artisanal voice.
Illustration-led identity: a rich custom icon set with textured grain, warm saturated color, hand-lettered headlines and gentle animation, giving the brand a crafted, storybook personality.

Warm heritage-modern identity: motifs drawn from local architecture and craft, a nostalgic yet clean serif or grotesque, tactile print finishes, and small surprising details hidden across menus, signage and packaging.

Contemporary tactile identity: characterful custom lettering, earthy and unexpected colour pairings, textures drawn from place and material, and a joyful, unpretentious tone that avoids worthy clichés.

Crafted, conceptual identity with restraint: thoughtful symbol rooted in place or story, refined serif and sans pairing, natural earthy palette, tactile print finishes, detailed illustration, premium but warm.
Thick-line Americana mark: heavy monoline strokes, badge and patch shapes, condensed bold sans or slab type, limited two-to-three color spot palette, workwear and outdoor heritage, honest and sturdy.

Authorial, collage-rich identity synthesizing a city or ingredient through fragments of everyday photography, expressive brush strokes and fine rule lines; rich packaging craft, poetic but commercial.
Rural vernacular: hand-painted lettering, woodcut-like illustrations, earthy pigments (ochre, clay, leaf green), crop and tool iconography, warm folk storytelling with contemporary restraint.

familias.mecanismo: color que choca, humor y tipografía enorme o deformada
descriptores: Maximalist, surreal art direction: hyper-saturated color, 3D and photographic set builds, bold custom type, emotional and provocative imagery, scroll-stopping social-first visuals.
Irreverent, loud identity with personality first: bold custom lettering, saturated or clashing colors, cheeky copywriting baked into the design, unapologetically fun.
Bold, irreverent branding with saturated single-hue worlds, oversized typography, surreal or tactile imagery (inflating balloons, textures), strong art-direction for food and culture.
Rule-breaking entertainment identity: a mark that deliberately misbehaves (cropped, bleeding, or partially hidden), vivid colour, cinematic motion, and a cheeky, fan-like tone.
Expressive editorial identity: inflated, playful letterforms and soft bubble shapes, high-contrast color pairings, and typography that behaves like illustration across covers, posters and motion.
Irreverent, ad-agency-minded identity: oversized playful type, unexpected colour clashes, humorous copy as a core asset, and packaging that behaves like a joke the shopper is in on.
Bold, idea-driven identity with a playful twist: big confident logotypes, strong illustrative or 3D gestures, punchy palettes and a sense of humor that makes the brand instantly memorable.
Expressive art-world identity: bold experimental typography that bends rules, collage and found imagery, high-contrast colour pops, and campaigns that change each edition like an artwork.

familias.mecanismo: tipografía propia amigable, un símbolo dibujable e identidad pensada como componentes de interfaz
descriptores: Purpose-driven tech identity anchored by a simple, single-stroke symbol anyone could draw, friendly rounded geometry, one ownable signature colour, and a warm, human photographic and illustrative system.

Playful, motion-first digital brand with a custom geometric typeface, bright optimistic palette, characterful mark that can animate or emote, and bold, simple illustration made for product screens and social.
Optimistic digital-product identity: friendly custom typeface, bright modern palette, 3D or illustrated mascot elements, UI-native components, motion-ready, approachable and global.

Bold, optimistic tech identity: duotone photography, vivid clashing color pairs, a simple mark that becomes a flexible frame, illustration and imagery from many collaborators held together by one strict color rule, joyful and loud.
Pragmatic yet expressive tech-and-culture identity: a letter-based monogram mark, crisp grotesk typography, bold flat color fields, playful motion moments.

Direct-to-consumer startup identity: friendly custom wordmark, soft pastel or deep signature color, conversational witty copy, lifestyle photography, illustration for explanation, approachable and trustworthy.
Digital-product-first identity: a connector-style graphic device linking content, custom sans developed with a type foundry, vibrant gradients for screens, and a system designed for UI before print.

Systematic brand-experience identity: a compact symbol derived from simple operators, a custom pictogram family, disciplined sans-serif typography, and consistent rules spanning app UI, stationery and space.
Challenger-brand identity that rejects category sameness: an unexpected organic palette, a dynamic horizon-like line device, punchy editorial type, and a defiant, plain-speaking voice.

familias.mecanismo: una forma contenedora que llenan otros (la comunidad, los clientes, el contenido)
descriptores: Warm, people-first identity: bright confident palette, friendly rounded sans-serif, bold headlines in plain human language, simple shapes that can be filled with community voices, inclusive and upbeat.

Open, participatory identity: a simple shape-based framework that anyone can fill or redraw, bright modern palette, friendly sans typography, toolkits that let clients generate on-brand material themselves.
Cause-led, hopeful identity: hand-cut shapes and playful illustration, a warm diverse palette, approachable rounded type, and imagery that invites participation instead of alarm.
Purpose-driven identity: clear, legible sans-serif, optimistic primary palette, data and illustration explaining complex missions, accessible layouts, human and hopeful.

Bold cultural-institutional identity with flexible, variable systems; fluorescent accents over clean grids, playful graphic patterns, wayfinding-minded clarity, community-oriented and optimistic voice.

Joyful geometric identity built from primary shapes (circles, half-circles, triangles) assembled into pictograms; flat saturated palette of 4–5 bold colors on white; geometric sans set large; illustration as a modular brand system, optimistic and warm.

A friendly character-led identity: a simple flat mascot with two solid colors and a minimal expressive face, paired with a clean sans-serif wordmark; the character carries the brand across merchandise, campaigns and social content.
Joyful, idea-led identity where one tiny graphic element (a dot, a line) becomes a mischievous character that interacts with type and content; clean grotesk, one punchy colour.

familias.mecanismo: pictogramas, código de color, escudo modernizado, historia del lugar convertida en patrón
descriptores: Systematic civic identity: bold pictograms, rigorous modular grid, strong primary color coding, sturdy sans-serif, designed for legibility at distance and massive repetition.

Architectural, wayfinding-born identity: thin geometric pictograms, precise sans-serif type aligned to a strict grid, a near-monochrome palette with one functional accent, and graphics that feel integrated into materials and space.
Civic-grade identity rooted in heritage: a modernised historic emblem, a bespoke typeface carrying local character, disciplined architecture for many sub-brands, and calm, trustworthy colour.
Civic identity with a heraldic core reduced to a clean modern symbol, a custom typeface, a bright friendly palette, speech-bubble or frame devices that let many departments speak with one voice.

Evolving geometric civic identity: a simple core shape broken into a kit of arcs and segments, a broad cheerful palette, plain-speaking honest copy, and rules that let the system change while staying recognizable.
Place-making identity: a mark and pattern drawn from the site's history and architecture, layered archival and contemporary photography, earthy urban palette, and wayfinding-ready typography.

Purposeful, emotionally warm identity built on one simple visual metaphor (a reflection, a frame, a moving line), confident sans typography, fresh natural colour, and motion that expresses what the product actually does.

Expansive brand-world system rather than a single logo: a kit of symbols, patterns and sculptural forms that can be recombined, rich colour, tactile physical expressions, and a friendly conversational voice.
Grounded national identity: a mark rooted in local landscape and indigenous visual culture, earthy natural palette, bilingual naming where relevant, and calm, confident typography.
Clean institutional-cooperative identity: clear sans-serif systems, product-sector sub-brands, pragmatic modular applications.
Sports-heritage identity: emblematic crest-like marks, bold athletic typography, national color palette, iconographic pictograms, proud and ceremonial.

Organic, nature-inspired identity where the mark is a dynamic, almost sculptural gesture that can be rendered in 3D, sound and touch; vibrant multi-hue palette, fluid curves, celebratory and human tone.
